description: The bar chart, titled “Evaluation Based on Different Tasks,” visually compares the performance accuracy of three distinct model configurations—“Base,” “RMU with Enhanced GCG,” and “RMU”—across two evaluation tasks: “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval.” The vertical y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 0.0 to 0.6 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, representing a linear scale of performance. The horizontal x-axis categorizes the two evaluation tasks. For “MCQ Eval,” the “Base” model (red bar) achieves an accuracy of 0.644, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (light green bar) scores 0.539, and the “RMU” (yellow bar) reaches 0.299. In “Generation Eval,” the “Base” model again leads with 0.597, followed by “RMU with Enhanced GCG” at 0.263, and “RMU” at 0.106. Each bar is color-coded and labeled with its exact accuracy value above it, and a legend at the bottom clarifies the color-to-model mapping. The chart does not sort bars by value within each group, and all bars are of equal width with no additional visual emphasis such as shading or outlines. The data suggests that the “Base” model consistently outperforms the other two across both tasks, while “RMU with Enhanced GCG” performs better than “RMU” in both evaluations.
